canonical_serialization: UTF-8; sorted object keys; compact separators; ensure_ascii=False; allow_nan=False; LF after every record; preserve input row order
notes: One typed record per native record; HelpSteer2 ratings retain five separate fields.
CivilComments uses toxicity annotation fraction >=0.5; native annotation fractions retained only outside model payload.
GSM8K synthetic alternatives are exact Decimal answer plus offsets -2,-1,+1,+2.
No calibration probabilities invented. Scores use enum strings for Nimble flat boolean/enum schema compatibility.
Original labels, rationales and raw_native are absent from model payload; gold and transformation trace are audit-only.
permutation: SHA256 of canonical JSON [seed, record_id, field, original_option_index], sorted ascending by digest with index tie break
